## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the missing-results fallback before merge because it allows release without saved checks. This review read both changed files in full and traced their branches against the tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a missing-file fallback for saved results and introduces display preferences with a default light theme.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Fail closed when saved results are missing — When the results path does not exist, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True`. Your new handler returns `[]`, and `all(...)` on that empty list succeeds, converting a missing-results error into release authorization. — A missing or mistyped results path allows release without any passing checks. — Fix: Preserve the missing-file error or explicitly deny release when results are unavailable.
